title: AAOIFI Stage 1 Unanswerable / Escalation Probe
description: Schema for data/probes/unanswerable_probes.jsonl - the mechanically labelled NEGATIVE class. A probe is not a hard-set item and must never be merged into data/private/hard_set.jsonl: its label is a fact about the corpus (or, for cross_standard_comparison, an explicitly stipulated definition), not a scholar judgement about Shari'ah. The vocabularies below deliberately do not overlap hard_set_schema.json on 'answerability' or 'status', so the two classes cannot be silently pooled. Probe questions are authored by this project and contain no AAOIFI clause prose, which is why data/probes/ is tracked while data/private/ is not. Generated and verified by scripts/build_unanswerable_probes.py; re-verified against the live corpus by aaoifi_rag.reporting.probes.verify_probes.

schema_version.description: Bumped when the probe field set changes.

probe_id.description: Prefix encodes the basis. U- probes expect abstain, E- probes expect escalate. Disjoint from hard-set item_ids (H01..H07) so the two sets can never collide in a metrics table.

question_text.description: Authored by this project. standard_absent_from_corpus probes name a standard by NUMBER ONLY and assert nothing about its subject matter, because AAOIFI's wider catalogue cannot be verified from this repository's files.

expected_behavior.description: Never 'answer'. Determined by unanswerable_basis, not authored independently: the three factual bases expect abstain, the stipulated cross-standard basis expects escalate.

unanswerable_basis.description: The first three are facts about the corpus. The fourth is a stipulation and carries the 'stipulation' block.

basis_evidence.description: Re-derivable justification; shape depends on unanswerable_basis. Only fields that verify_probe actually recomputes belong here - an unchecked count would be exactly the stale label this design prevents.

corpus_occurrences.description: Chunks containing the term as a whole word. Must be 0 or the probe is answerable.

of_chunks.description: Corpus size at build time. A mismatch means the corpus changed and the probe must be rebuilt.

standard_id.description: Must BE indexed; otherwise use standard_absent_from_corpus.

clause_id.description: Must not exist in that standard.

verification_basis.description: Both are strictly weaker than corpus_cross_reference and neither is qualified_scholar_review. Widening aaoifi_rag.reporting.evaluation.VERIFICATION_BASES to admit them does not change is_scholar_validated, which remains gated on qualified_scholar_review alone.

requires_scholar.description: False for every probe by construction. This is the entire reason the negative class can be built in Stage 1 without expert time.

stipulation.description: Present if and only if unanswerable_basis is cross_standard_comparison. Repeated in full on every such probe so a stray probe file still carries its own caveat.

warning.description: States that escalation precision and recall are conditional on accepting the definition.
